Whole Inorganic chapter completion is recorded separately; other curricula, paper archive and examiner/AI work remain unfinished.

requirements.judgement: Ore mixture, oxide compound and metal species distinguished: concentrating 200 kg to 100 kg retains 40 kg oxide, changing 20% to 40% without making iron; independent 150−60=90 kg and 30/90=one third practice.
Native gold grains already contain uncombined element; physical collection versus oxide reduction contrasted. Often-native tendency does not exclude compound occurrences or contamination.
Physical removal of iron-free rock leaves iron chemically combined in oxide. Increased oxide fraction is neither elemental-metal yield nor chemical reduction.
Carbon school position below Al and above Fe supports suitable oxide method selection, not an unconditional industrial route for every compound.
Actual Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂ independently conserves Fe2/C3/O6; iron oxide loses oxygen and CO gains it. Carbon-based route distinguished from CO product confusion.
Aluminium above carbon uses electrolysis of alumina in the appropriate molten bath; simple carbon heating and ordinary aqueous-salt deposition explicitly not substituted.

Mobile electrolyte ions versus external electrons and negative cathode electron gain distinguished. Actual doubled half-equation +6−6=0 conserves Al2; carbon anode conductance/consumption does not reclassify the method.
Suitable compound and process conditions retained; fixed solid ions and competing aqueous water reactions limit transfer. Balanced formula alone is not evidence of a viable route.
Interpret supplied starting oxide, physical separation, metal-forming step and inputs without requiring a factory recipe; iron-free remainder assumption prevents hidden metal-content inference.
Independent rational calculations: A 250×.20×112/160=35 kg theoretical and ×.80=28 recovered; B 200×.30×112/160=42 and ×.75=31.5; unfamiliar C 80×.25×.70=14 and ×.90=12.6.
Recovered-output denominator independently gives A140/28=5, B189/31.5=6, C75.6/12.6=6 MJ/kg; larger recovery per batch is not automatically lower energy per kilogram.

Recommendation names product quality, waste composition/treatment and energy source with comparable boundaries. Current alone does not prove carbon footprint, and unrecovered iron need not be elemental metal waste.

Own source italic 2.24C limitation explicitly preserved: detailed specific extraction processes not required. Invented unfamiliar batch practice tests interpretation rather than compulsory industrial memorization.

Low-density aircraft benefit separated from appropriate alloy strength. Supplied equal-volume density model gives 100 cm³ masses270/896 g and unfamiliar50 cm³135/448 g; no strength certificate inferred.
Aluminium utensil links thermal conductivity and malleable forming to the job; oxide-supported corrosion resistance explained separately from intrinsic chemical reactivity.
Copper-wire explanation uses electrical conductivity for current and ductility for drawing; low density rejected as the conductivity mechanism.
Copper heat-exchanger thermal transfer and plumbing workability/conditional corrosion resistance distinguish actual use benefits from immunity claims.
Suitable soft iron magnetizes readily and releases much magnetization after field removal for a switched electromagnet; pure iron and all steel grades not interchangeable.
Mild-steel formability versus suitably treated high-carbon edge hardness assessed. Hardness, toughness and ductility distinguished, with no universal hardest-and-toughest claim.
Stainless chromium supports a chromium-rich oxide layer and conditional cutlery/sink corrosion resistance; neither a pure-chromium coating nor immunity asserted.

Grade/treatment restrictions retained; nickel-free and magnetic stainless possibilities defeat blanket identification rules. All three named steel types are taught, not new compulsory grade thresholds.
Alloy defined as metal plus one or more elements; iron/carbon qualifies despite non-metal carbon, and exactly-two-metals definition rejected.
Different supplied steel percentages remain variable alloy mixtures, not one fixed compound formula. Two-element and three-element bookkeeping assumptions stated.
Independent .004×3 kg=.012 kg=12 g; unfamiliar2.5 kg at12%Cr/.80%C gives.30/.020/2.18 kg and87.2%Fe. Composition alone does not certify a particular hardness after every treatment.
Actual SVG pure panel has15 equal-sized atoms in three regular rows; explanation connects regularity with plastic movement rather than complete loss of metallic bonding.

Actual alloy SVG substitutes one larger radius38 atom for a radius25 site and displaces neighbours; explanation rejects added-whole-layer and measured-coordinates claims. Smaller/substitutional versus interstitial possibilities qualified.
Distortion hinders plastic movement, requiring more force; independent32/20=1.6 same-endpoint supplied comparison is consistent with hardening, not impossible deformation.
2D schematic explicitly original, illustrative and non-measured; other phases/composition/treatment and matched geometry/endpoints limit mechanism/toughness and universal-alloy inferences.

practiceReview.scope: Forty new original per-section practice additions only; existing explanations, worked examples, requirement judgements and diagrams unchanged.

changedSections.question: An invented ore is iron oxide mixed with iron-free rock, while another sample contains native gold grains. Which species already contains uncombined metal, and does removing rock reduce iron oxide?

Place aluminium, carbon and iron in the relevant school extraction comparison. In Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂, identify the species gaining oxygen. Does every below-carbon compound need the identical iron-furnace recipe?
Explain why molten ionic bath ions and external circuit electrons have distinct roles. Write Al³⁺ reduction and correct “a carbon anode makes this simple carbon heating of alumina”.
Invented routes recover 8 kg using 48 MJ and 12 kg using 60 MJ. Compare energy per recovered kilogram and say why the lower figure alone cannot prove the best overall process.
Choose useful property links for copper wire, a copper heat exchanger and a low mass structural aluminium-alloy part. Does corrosion resistance imply no reaction in every environment?
A formable panel, hard cutting edge and moisture-exposed cutlery need different features. Name the three required steel types and correct “all stainless contains nickel and is nonmagnetic”.
An invented 5 kg iron-carbon material contains 0.60%carbon and no other elements. Calculate both masses. Does carbon being nonmetal or a change of percentage stop it qualifying as an alloy?
Using the original one-larger-atom model, explain the chain from atomic size to hardness. Must every alloy have more layers, lose metallic bonds or become impossible to deform?
